text:
maria: Heads up — we've started seeing NVLink/AER flaps on pool6-node12, recurring ~every 7-10m, causing batch jobs to OOM/fail and scheduler to evict tasks. Logs: `Xid 62 AER: mem err` and `nvlink: link down`.
ashok: saw the spike on infra-dashboard, latency for embeddings up ~30% in pool6 :grimacing:
kevin: which node and gpus?
maria: pool6-node12, GPUs 2/3 flip, kernel logs pasted below:
```
[ 12345.678901] pcie aer: Uncorrected error: Device: 0000:3b:00.1
[ 12345.678905] nvlink0: link 1 down
[ 12352.000012] Xid (AER 62): Load/store ECC error
```
julia: can we drain that node? might be reseat riser or hot-swap card.
maria: i'd like to drain and move jobs off. Capacity impact: pool6 has 8 nodes, losing this one drops concurrency ~12%.
kevin: start drain, but keep one GPU online for repro, label others unsched.
maria: running: `rdctl nodes drain pool6-node12 --exclude-gpu 2 --reason "nvlink-flap"`
oncall-bot: Scheduled drain for pool6-node12 by maria at 1718202468. ETA 2m.
ashok: can we route new embeddings requests away from pool6 until fixed? set routing tag `region=east && pool!=pool6`.
maria: temporary policy pushed: `rbac-route set --match "pool=pool6" --fallback "pool=pool2"`
kevin: also enable fallback model variant on Dedicated to avoid OOMs during transient capacity loss.
julia: if reseat doesn't help, plan is hotcard swap during next maintenance window or RMA. I'll prepare spare card.
ashok: quick triage checklist: 1) BIOS version check 2) PCIe AER frequency 3) NVLink firmware versions 4) confirm temps and power rails.
maria: temps normal, BIOS 1.2.3, nvlink fw 4.5. Saw a small bump in PCIe AER after last week's kernel patch.
kevin: create incident ticket and mark P1 if rate > 5/hour. I'll open INC-2026-045.
maria: added short-term mitigation: decrease batch size for embedding jobs on pool6 to reduce memory pressure and OOMs.
ashok: started collector query: `curl -s "https://metrics/api/query?expr=sum(rate(node_pci_aer_total{node=\"pool6-node12\"}[5m]))"`
maria: query returned 6.2 — above P1 threshold. escalating.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created by kevin. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-045
julia: i'll schedule hands-on on-site tonight for slot reseat/hot-swap. any objections?
kevin: none, go for it. :thumbsup:
maria: FYI for capacity planning — if this becomes long-term we'll spin up an extra node in pool6 region to keep SLAs.
ashok: k8s taints applied, workloads migrating now.
maria: i'll update this thread with the postmortem after swap/RMA or config fix.
kevin: ack.
